name: Should I hire a handyman or a general remodeling contractor for home repairs?

mainEntity.name: Should I hire a handyman or a general remodeling contractor for home repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard handyman is ideal for minor punch-list tasks like hanging pictures or replacing doorknobs, but a general remodeling contractor is the better choice when repairs involve framing, drywall texture matching, custom tile, or structural finish carpentry. Choosing a contractor provides higher craftsmanship on finish work and ensures proper management if a small repair reveals broader damage behind the wall. HH Remodeling LLC bridges this gap by offering both small repair services and full remodeling capabilities. As an owner-operated business, Abraham Becerra directly leads carpentry and drywall work while managing licensed trade partners when electrical or plumbing issues arise, giving you single-source accountability.
acceptedAnswer.description: Use a general remodeling contractor when repairs involve drywall, finish carpentry, tile, or potential structural issues that exceed basic punch-list tasks.
